shape_hint: Pan head machine screw: a low cylindrical head with a flat bearing face and slightly domed top (diameter A, height H, small top radius R), with either a straight slot (width J, depth T) or a Phillips cross recess in the top, on a fully threaded straight shank of diameter D with a plain/chamfered end.

role_map.H1_min: head height min, Type I cross recessed pan head
role_map.PH_no: Phillips driver (recess) number for Type I recess

notes: Table covers PAN head only (slotted and Type I cross recessed share A, but head height differs: use H for slotted, H1 for Phillips). Other ASME B18.6.3 head styles (flat, oval, round, fillister, truss, binding, hex) are NOT covered here; several exist on the same sources (e.g. torqbolt, boltingspecialist, engineersedge, aftfasteners). Sizes kept #2..1/2 (13 rows). Thread columns: UNC coarse and UNF fine TPI per ASME B1.1 (#5-40 UNC / #5-44 UNF; #2 56/64 ...). Source defects seen: AFT has '..023/..043/..048' double-dot typos (read as .023/.043/.048, other sites confirm); engineersedge label '.5635' for 9/16; echosupply gives #6 D = 0.136 (typo for 0.138) and rounds 5/16, 7/16 to 0.313/0.438; ETB rounds the same way. Values are max/min limits as published; lengths and thread length rules (B18.6.3) are not included.

verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded all 16 listed URLs live (globalfastener detail_4989 returned 403 on the first try, OK with Referer header). Parsed torqbolt, boltingspecialist (slotted+cross), AFT, gf 4988/4989, engineersedge, china-bolts cross page into row x column dicts and compared EVERY kept cell (13 rows x 12 head/driver cols = 156 cells) against every source that lists it: 0 numeric disagreements. Thread block (13 rows x D/tpi_unc/tpi_unf = 39 cells) compared against ETB, runsom, echosupply, threadspec, productionscrews, trfastenings, concretecalculate, rivcut, gf, torqbolt(D), china-bolts(P): 0 disagreements except known rounding/typo (ETB/runsom/echosupply 5/16=0.313, 7/16=0.438; echosupply #6=0.136) which I excluded; >=4 clusters per thread/D cell. Head-cell cluster counts (torq,bs,aft,gf,ee,cb as separate clusters): A_max 5-6, A_min 4-5, H_max 4-5, H_min 3-4, R_max 4, J 4-5/3-4, T 4-5/3-4, H1 3-4, PH_no 3-4; every row except 7/16 has >=4 on every min/H1/PH cell. Re-ran counts with torq+bs merged and with china-bolts merged into gf and with both merged: rows #2..3/8 and 1/2 still >=3 on every cell in ALL readings; only 7/16 falls to 2 (H_min,J_min,T_min if torq=bs; H1_max,H1_min,PH_no if cb=gf). Independence evidence torq vs bs: different legal entities (TorqBolt Pvt Ltd, R R Roy Rd vs Resistant Metal Alloys LLP, Nanubhai Desai Rd), different table markup/columns (torqbolt has D column + 'ANSI B18.6.3 -' labels + trimmed zeros, bs keeps 3 decimals), different footnote wording on all 3 head types (neither is a subset of the other), no shared typo, no cross-links on either site; fasteners.eu has no ASME B18.6.3 page (404) so torqbolt is not fasteners.eu-derived here; torqbolt has no cross-recess pages (404). Sanity: max>min on all 6 pairs, A_max>D, H1>H, UNF>UNC TPI, D equals decimal of the row label for all 13 rows, all head dims non-decreasing with size, TPI non-increasing.
problems: Load-bearing judgement: torqbolt and boltingspecialist counted as 2 clusters (evidence in checks_done). If the owner prefers the strict merge (or merges china-bolts into globalfastener), drop ONLY row 7/16 (exactly 3 clusters on H_min,J_min,T_min = torq+bs+gf and on H1_max,H1_min,PH_no = bs+gf+china-bolts; AFT has no 7/16 row). All other rows stay >=3 under every merge combination.

Scope/label: values are PAN head only (slotted H,R,J,T + Type I cross-recess H1,PH_no). Family label '인치 작은나사 (머신스크류)' is generic; head columns must keep the 팬머리 wording and the page must not imply flat/oval/round/truss/hex head dims.

Semantics read from headers, not inferred: A (Head Dia), H (Head Height), R (Head Radius, max only), J (Slot Width), T (Slot Depth: torqbolt pan page prints a duplicate 'Head Height, H' header for this pair; bs/engineersedge/AFT/gf n,t order all say slot depth), PH_no = 'Driver Size'/'Socket No.' of Type I recess. 'H1' is the producer's key (AFT literally uses H1; ASME and bs/gf use H/k for the cross-recess head height).
Producer row drops confirmed: #1 and 9/16,5/8,3/4 have H1/PH only from bs+gf (AFT and china-bolts omit them) = 2 clusters; #0 has no UNC thread (UNF 80 only) so a UNC cell would be empty.
R_max is non-smooth (5/16 0.099 -> 3/8 0.143 -> 7/16 0.153) but identical in torq, bs, gf, engineersedge, so it is the published standard value, not a typo.
Source defects seen and not used: AFT '..023/..043/..048' double dots (read as .023/.043/.048, other sites confirm), engineersedge label '.5635' (=9/16), echosupply #6 D 0.136, rounded 0.313/0.438.
D for 5/16 and 7/16 = 0.3125/0.4375 (6 sites incl. torqbolt, gf, rivcut, threadspec, productionscrews, trfastenings); the 3-decimal 0.313/0.438 sites differ numerically and are not counted.

standard_full: ASME B18.6.3 (pan head: slotted and Type I cross recessed) + ASME B1.1 (UNC/UNF threads)
